description: This file defines the RegistrationEventQueueDao class, responsible for data access operations related to RegistrationEventQueue entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving registration events, fetching events by type, and retrieving unpublished events, adhering to the system's HRM functionalities.

classes.name: RegistrationEventQueueDao
classes.description: Data access object for RegistrationEventQueue entities, providing methods to save, retrieve by type, and fetch unpublished registration events.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Persists a RegistrationEventQueue entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventByType
methods.description: Retrieves a single RegistrationEventQueue entity matching the specified event type, ordered by descending ID.

methods.name: getUnpublishedRegistrationEvents
methods.description: Fetches a list of unpublished RegistrationEventQueue entities up to the specified limit.
